answer: The CNIL report suggests that the design of algorithmic systems should focus on enhancing user autonomy and reflexivity. It emphasizes the importance of creating systems that allow users to understand the algorithms' functioning and to make informed decisions. One example given to illustrate this is the "Politoscope," developed by the Institut des Systèmes Complexes de Paris-Île de France. This tool enables the public to explore large datasets and see the activity and strategies of political communities on social networks, thereby helping users to engage actively and critically with the information presented to them.
